scope: current implementation; proposed advanced-module redesign is not implemented

checks.title: Newborn slaughter versus real item mass
Healthy and critically ill cattle yield the same meat
Milk can be collected from a newborn male calf
Panel hand-feeding has no resource or world-time cost

evidence.seam: real panel handler and real inventory; rendering suppressed; no real browser interaction

checks.title: Actual processing panel consumes a crop then fails at an absent inventory API
Direct feeding a full trough still consumes inventory
Existing queued feed is consumed with no output capacity
Refiner occupies the only currently buildable side trough slot
Unfed pigs retain mass and do not uproot grass
A full-weight pig still spends the growth ration
Three sheep cannot maintain five chickens even with abundant pollution on both sides
checks.qualification: A favorable food-availability fixture, not a claim that the sheep herd survives long-term at pollution 80.

checks.title: Chickens keep cleaning after their occupied coop is dismantled
Identical animals receive different feed based on insertion order
Sheep/pig update order changes pollution at the zero boundary
Warehouse counts item types, allowing hundreds of physical products in one slot

evidence.fixture: density edge case; no configured zone animal cap

checks.title: At full distinct-key capacity, collected output is lost rather than sent to the backpack
checks.qualification: Injected boundary state: current four species do not naturally supply 50 distinct living product types.

checks.title: Climate mode cooldown does not advance
Link sowing can run without source/executor modules and lasts only one tick
Clean-collect spends scheduling points without collecting a ready animal
Simultaneous manure generation hides actual cleaning from recovery
Only the first heat arm recovers; both consume power
A zero-satiety, birth-weight pig can reproduce after age-based maturity
checks.qualification: Eligibility boundary with forced random success; not a measurement of average population growth.

checks.title: Carrying hermaphrodite does not give either-sex behavior
Synchronous rotation preserves relative animal/trough service and restores geometry after four turns
Two cows leave grass above the sheep feeding ceiling at the first handover
checks.qualification: Design/balance lock, not a floating-point bug. Initial grass 1.5 m and compaction 0; no mowing module.

checks.title: Serialization and reload preserve a deterministic mixed-herd continuation
checks.qualification: Runtime JSON roundtrip only, not a browser SaveSystem end-to-end test or general RNG serialization proof.

checks.title: Early growth perk is inactive on pig feed-based growth
Unfed breeding pigs grow their population across seeded runs
checks.qualification: Biological/resource-budget risk; nutrition-free gestation is permitted by current eligibility rules. Does not measure infinite growth.

checks.title: With no pollution and no feed chicken satiety declines and starvation occurs
Queued maize transfers to a trough with space
checks.qualification: Post-repair control uses configured level-1 throughput, checks conservation including partially processed input. Baseline evidence retains the historical 10-units expectation.
